items.title: VST Q3 Earnings Beat on Strong Power Pricing, Revenues Rise Y/Y
items.summary: Vistra's Q3 earnings surge 84.6% on stronger power pricing and retail margins, while revenues climb 27.7%, prompting higher 2026 EBITDA guidance.

items.title: Constellation CEO Sounds the Alarm: Data Center Demand Was a “Massive Overestimation.” Its Nuclear Contracts Run to the 2040s
items.summary: Key TakeawaysConstellation Energy CEO Joe Dominguez said utilities and grid operators made a “massive overestimation” of data center demand. Days earlier, Vistra’s CEO blamed speculative developers for overstated grid queues.

items.title: Constellation and Vistra Get the Headlines. These 2 Power Producers Barely Get Mentioned.
items.summary: Talen Energy and NRG Energy receive less attention than Constellation and Vistra, but both are expanding power capacity to meet AI data center demand.

items.title: Energy Transition Today - Cleantech Innovation Fuels Economic Growth and Competitiveness
items.summary: Foresight Canada has announced the 2026 Foresight 50 Honorees, highlighting a group of high-growth cleantech companies that are driving the energy transition with their innovative solutions. These companies, selected by an independent panel of climate investors, have collectively raised over USD $2.4 billion and are recognized for their investibility, leadership strength, and environmental impact. items.title: NRG Soars 10% on $4 Billion Gas Plant Sale and $3 Billion Buyback Plan: “Unlocking Substantial Value”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysNRG Energy jumped 10% after agreeing to sell six gas plants to LS Power for $4 billion and raising its 2026-27 buyback plan to $3 billion. Buying back a stock this cheap is a smart use of the cash, though half goes to debt.

items.title: Vistra Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Cash Flow Plans & Demand Risks
items.summary: VST raises its 2026 outlook and projects stronger cash flow per share through 2030, backed by Cogentrix, power contracts and buybacks despite demand risks.

items.title: Data-Center Moratoriums? They Aren’t Showing Up in Constellation Energy’s Guidance.
items.summary: Constellation Energy raises full-year earnings guidance even as the U.S midterm elections have made some on Wall Street concerned the data-center buildout could stall.

items.title: Vistra and Constellation Both Fell Sharply After the Election. One Has Far More Exposure to Texas.
items.summary: The two power producers both face tough near-term challenges.
